_comment: Banked-memory validation target (MAME 0.289, set '1942' = 1942 (Revision B)). Test fixture data only: the server contains none of this.

rom_zip.note: merged set from the local MAME 0.289 ROM collection; read only; -verifyroms 1942 reports good

source.file: src/mame/capcom/1942.cpp (tag mame0289, fetched from the mamedev/mame repository, source only)
source.register_note: 0xC806 is write-only (no read handler); the selected entry is observable only through bank.entry (Lua) or by reading the window

maincpu.frame_handler_note: RST 10h vector at 0x10: PUSH HL(0x10);PUSH DE(0x11);PUSH BC(0x12);PUSH AF(0x13);JP 0196h. Entered about once per frame during attract mode. Captures use 0x11 and an independent observer 0x12. A Lua-requested debugger stop lands at 0x10 (12/12 tries), and MAME does not re-trigger a breakpoint at the PC it resumes from, so a capture at 0x10 would miss that first instance.

natural_select.note: the game's own write to 0xC806 after reset; observed by watchpoint. Only value 0 was observed in attract mode and in about 60 s after a coin/start input (not shown to be real gameplay); non-zero entries were reached by harness interventions

maincpu.attract_mode_pc_note: 300 PC samples all fell in 0x0000-0x0FFF (frame-wait loop near 0x91-0x9A): the window is not executed, so a changed bank is safe while it is held

unequal_rates.note: Z80 :maincpu. hot = per-frame RST 10h handler (about 60/s); rare = instruction after 'ld (hl),1' at 0x2BA0 (selects bank entry 1; observed a few times per several seconds in attract mode). Observers sit at the next instruction boundary of each.

audiocpu.note: its 0x8000-0x87FF is RAM, not the banked window

backing_region.entry_offset_rule: 0x10000 + 0x4000 * entry (from configure_entries; established by source and by the byte comparison in the validation)

1.note: only the first 0x2000 bytes come from a ROM file; the rest of the 0x4000 entry is the region's 0xFF erase fill

3.note: entry 3 maps region offset 0x1C000 which has no ROM file: 0xFF erase fill
